test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F were six friends playing games around a circular table. They were standing facing the centre of the table. E was standing to the immediate left of A. C was second to the left of F. There were exactly two people between D and A. B was at the immediate right of A. Which friend was at the immediate right of F?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, E, and F were six friends playing games around a circular table. They were standing facing the center of the table.

1. E was standing to the immediate left of A.

2. B was at the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a50d865df97d4026bfcab911473fe7466418f28ecd11c2aa641af06b10837555.png] 

3. There were exactly two people between D and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/534e660b2171f4895401e0360334fb0d2d4926acc83f814012f51da7d7ffaad2.png] 

4. C was second to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33fce0d7852879aa2a145efa3c42711ef52c4ad84dff6b840659ebc28c4fde99.png] 

So, **'E'** is standing immediately right of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
